# rustinion_process_watch_rules (Data Source)

Looks up every process-watch rule belonging to one group, without managing them. The server's own list endpoint (GET /api/v1/customer/process-watch-rules) is tenant-wide with no group filter, matching rustinion_log_alert_rule's own list shape — this data source filters that result client-side to group_id, a deliberate, simple design choice rather than a workaround.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Only rules belonging to this group are returned.

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes List) Every process-watch rule in group_id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String)
- `process_name` (String)
